title: Editorial: Align with Web IDL specification
body:
This is an automated pull request to align the spec with the latest Web IDL specification. Currently the autofix might introduce some awkward code formatting, so please feel free to modify the formatting. Please file an issue on https://github.com/saschanaz/webidl-updater/issues/new if you think this PR is invalid or should be enhanced.
